name: cruise
description: Plan, review, and carry out software work with Codex.

interface.longDescription: Cruise helps turn a coding request into the right-sized plan, change, investigation, or research task. It asks only the questions that change the result and keeps Codex's normal safety checks in charge.
defaultPrompt: Use $cruise:build to plan a new project or major milestone.
Use $cruise:refine to plan and carry out this feature.
Use $cruise:goal to carry out this larger migration.
